class_name: 放置-継続-ナイデイル類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Reports the state of continuing not to do something, by choice or from inability: 口をきかないでいる, 泣かずにいた. The subject is normally animate and volitional, and する appears as せずに in the stiffer ずに variant. ないでおく instead leaves something undone deliberately with a later purpose in view. The ばかり and さえ shapes such as ないでばかりいる are rare and add a critical "does nothing but" coloring.

examples.ruby: 息子[むすこ]は叱[しか]られてから、一言[ひとこと]も口[くち]をきかないでいる。
examples.english: Ever since he got scolded, my son hasn't said a word to us.

examples.ruby: 怖[こわ]くて、検査[けんさ]の結果[けっか]を見[み]ないでいる。
examples.english: I'm too scared to look, so I've been leaving the test results unread.

examples.ruby: 悔[くや]しくても、私[わたし]は泣[な]かずにいた。
examples.english: Bitter as it was, I kept myself from crying.

patterns.usage_note: The same continuing-not-to-do state as ないでいる, built on おる: まだ伝えないでおります. In 〜ないでおります it is 謙譲語, used about yourself or your own company toward a customer, so applying it to the listener's own state typically sounds rude. Plain 〜ないでおる is blunt, or Western-Japanese and older-speaker flavored, rather than neutrally polite.

examples.ruby: その件[けん]はまだ社長[しゃちょう]に伝[つた]えないでおります。
examples.english: We have not yet informed the president of the matter.

examples.ruby: 差[さ]し出[で]がましいので、こちらからは連絡[れんらく]せずにおります。
examples.english: It would be presumptuous of us, so we have refrained from reaching out.

examples.ruby: 祖父[そふ]は昨日[きのう]から薬[くすり]を飲[の]まないでおる。
examples.english: Grandpa's been going without his medicine since yesterday.
